title: Project Spotlight - Portman St. Terraces By Smart Design Studio
bodyHtml:
Portman St. Terraces by Smart Design Studio

In this month’s Project Spotlight, we tour Portman St. Terraces in Green Square with William Smart, Founder & Principal of multi-award winning Smart Design Studio.

In this rare and candid walkthrough, William shares his design approach to the reimagined terrace houses — creating an urban typology that’s both bold and elegantly restrained. From proportion and materiality to function and light, it’s a masterclass in architectural clarity.⁠

Watch Here


Portman St Terraces, Green Square - Delivered by Mirvac

Matte White Bathware

Studio Bagno is proud to feature in the bathrooms of Portman St. Terraces with our matte white toilets and basins — selected for their soft tactility and ability to recede into the design vision.

Quiet yet expressive, these pieces complement the language of the architecture without drawing focus.


Milady Wall Hung Pan in Matte White and Blink Flush Plate


Hyde Basins in Matte White

The Architect

Smart Design Studio is one of Australia’s most awarded architecture firms, known for work that is highly considered, formally expressive, and deeply attuned to context.

Their projects reflect a consistent design philosophy — one that values function, material integrity, and spatial clarity. Portman St. Terraces exemplifies this approach, bringing refinement and presence to a modern interpretation of the Terrace House.

Mirvac: Shaping the Future of Urban Living

Developed by Mirvac, Portman St. Terraces is part of the broader transformation of Green Square into one of Sydney’s most desirable precincts — an urban village defined by design integrity and liveability.
